---
title: "bharatpii Privacy Audit Report"
date: "`r params$report_data$generated_on`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    self_contained: true
  pdf_document:
    toc: true
params:
  report_data: null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
d <- params$report_data
table_format <- if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html"
```

# Overview

This report presents a technical assessment of identifier detection and
privacy risk. It is not legal advice or a certification of compliance.

```{r overview}
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Measure = c("Rows scanned", "Detection threshold", "Report date"),
    Result = c(
      as.character(d$n_rows),
      format(d$threshold, trim = TRUE),
      d$generated_on
    )
  ),
  format = table_format,
  escape = TRUE
)
```

# Column-level audit results

The report contains column names and detection metadata, not the underlying
identifier values.

```{r audit-results}
knitr::kable(d$columns, format = table_format, escape = TRUE)
```

# Re-identification risk

```{r reidentification}
if (is.null(d$reid)) {
  cat("No separate re-identification assessment was supplied.")
} else {
  knitr::kable(d$reid, format = table_format, escape = TRUE)
}
```

# DPDP technical score

```{r score-summary}
if (is.null(d$score_summary)) {
  cat("No DPDP technical score was supplied.")
} else {
  knitr::kable(d$score_summary, format = table_format, escape = TRUE)
  knitr::kable(d$score_breakdown, format = table_format, escape = TRUE)
}
```

# Anonymisation summary

```{r anonymisation}
if (is.null(d$anonymisation)) {
  cat("No anonymisation result was supplied.")
} else {
  knitr::kable(
    d$anonymisation$changes,
    format = table_format,
    escape = TRUE
  )

  if (!is.null(d$anonymisation$risk_before)) {
    cat("\n\n**Re-identification risk before anonymisation**\n\n")
    knitr::kable(
      d$anonymisation$risk_before,
      format = table_format,
      escape = TRUE
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(d$anonymisation$risk_after)) {
    cat("\n\n**Re-identification risk after anonymisation**\n\n")
    knitr::kable(
      d$anonymisation$risk_after,
      format = table_format,
      escape = TRUE
    )
  }
}
```

---

*Generated by bharatpii. Risk tiers and scores are package-defined technical
conventions. Identifier validity does not prove that an identifier was issued.*
